description: Exact obstruction: the crossing-orientation mirror that def:down-quark states as its mechanism forces Q(d) = -Q(u), which is incompatible with the asserted +2/3 / -1/3 and makes the neutron non-neutral whenever the proton is charged.

computation.arithmetic: exact rational (fractions.Fraction) throughout; no floating point, no numerical q anchor

mirror_is_odd.claim: Q(n_-, n_+) = -Q(n_+, n_-) for all crossing counts

ratio_obstruction.claim: no crossing count gives the asserted ratio

summary.scope: (b) structural exclusion of the STATED MECHANISM, not of the framework deriving fractional charge by another route
summary.invariant_cited: oddness of the Coulomb charge under crossing-orientation reversal, which down-quark.lean proves relates the two quarks (quark_crossing_asymmetry)
summary.headline: the mechanism predicts Q(neutron) = -Q(proton); neutron neutrality forces every quark charge to 0
summary.note: Two independent failures, either alone sufficient: the ratio must be -1 and is asserted as -2; and Q lies in (1/2)Z so thirds are unreachable for every braid word. The Standard Model assignment needs |Q_u| = 2|Q_d|, an asymmetry between the two orientations that a pure mirror cannot supply.
